title: Retail credit risk manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Retail credit risk manager em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.    As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.      About the role    Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.    We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.      What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability    What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English    Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL      Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.  Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.  We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.  By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Qc - manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Qc - manager em vargem grande paulista. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Oversee all analytical testing activities to ensure compliance with GMP, GLP, ANVISA RDC, and other applicable regulatory requirements, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and traceability throughout all operations, maintaining the laboratory in a state of inspection readiness. Ensure robust method transfer processes are in place and executed effectively, collaborating closely with R&D, manufacturing, and third-party contractors. Drive the timely release of analytical results within schedules while maintaining stringent quality standards. Manage the acquisition, qualification, calibration, and maintenance of all QC laboratory equipment and instrumentation. Oversee the entire process for chemicals, reagents, and reference standards management, from procurement to disposal, ensuring supply chain integrity and compliance. Establish and maintain robust quality systems within QC, including OOS/Deviation management, CAPA effectiveness, change control, and risk management. Provide strategic direction for complex method troubleshooting, OOS investigations and other quality related process. Forecast and manage the departmental budget, including staffing, equipment, consumables, and external services. Develop and implement the strategic vision and operational plans for the QC department, aligning with the company overall business objectives and quality goals. Actively participate in internal and external regulatory audits (e.g., ANVISA, client audits), providing expert responses and presenting laboratory data and processes. Act as a primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all QC-related discussions during internal and external audits. Lead the preparation and response to audit findings, ensuring timely and effective CAPA implementation and closure. Stay abreast of new and evolving pharmaceutical regulations and industry best practices, ensuring the QC department remains fully compliant. Establish and monitor departmental Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to drive efficiency, compliance, and quality improvements. Oversee recruitment, training, performance management, and career development for all QC personnel. Ensure adequate staffing levels and competencies to meet operational demands and future growth. Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, identify training needs, and support the professional development of team members. Promote a strong safety, continuous improvement and proactive problem-solving culture within the laboratory, ensuring all team members adhere to EHS policies and procedures. Collaborate effectively with other departments such as Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and Project Management to ensure seamless operations and achieve company goals. Participate in management review meetings, product development teams, and other cross-functional committees as required.Experience- 5 to 15 Years

Você é orientado por dados, usando CRM e ferramentas de vendas modernas para priorizar atividades, gerir pipeline e prever com precisão. O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas. Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável. Sobre a Oportunidade: A Biogénesis Bagó Saúde Animal é uma empresa com atuação voltada ao desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras para saúde animal, contribuindo para a prevenção de doenças, o fortalecimento da pecuária e a evolução de tecnologias aplicadas ao setor veterinário. Em um cenário de alta demanda por produtos biológicos mais robustos, seguros e escaláveis, a empresa busca fortalecer sua capacidade de PD&I em vacinas veterinárias. O projeto tem como foco o desenvolvimento de vacinas vivas atenuadas multivalentes para bovinos, contemplando desde as etapas laboratoriais de cultivo celular e viral, purificação, formulação e liofilização até a validação pré-clínica e clínica dos produtos. Se você tem formação em Farmácia, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia, Engenharia de Bioprocessos, Engenharia Bioquímica ou áreas correlatas, e interesse em atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos biológicos para saúde animal, essa oportunidade é para você. Buscamos um perfil técnico, analítico e inovador, com conhecimento em formulação, estabilidade, purificação, UF/DF e integração de etapas produtivas, preparado para contribuir com soluções de alto impacto para a indústria veterinária. Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado completo em : Farmácia, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia, Engenharia de Bioprocessos, Biotecnologia, Engenharia Bioquímica e áreas afins Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos. Projeto: Desenvolvimento de vacinas vivas atenuadas multivalentes para prevenção de doenças respiratórias e reprodutivas em bovinos. Principais Atividades: Desenvolvimento de vacinas para a saúde animal, participando de um projeto estratégico de alto impacto. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem: Conduzir o desenvolvimento de vacinas multivalentes, desde as etapas laboratoriais até a preparação para escala industrial. Planejar e executar estudos experimentais avançados, com foco na otimização e controle de processos (Qb D). Desenvolver e aprimorar etapas críticas do processo, com destaque para liofilização, garantindo estabilidade e viabilidade do produto. Atuar no escalonamento de bioprocessos, assegurando reprodutibilidade, robustez e desempenho em ambiente industrial. Aplicar e desenvolver métodos analíticos (PCR, titulação viral, ensaios biológicos) para garantir a qualidade e confiabilidade dos resultados. Integrar diferentes etapas produtivas (cultivo celular, replicação viral, purificação, formulação e liofilização) de forma consistente e eficiente. Analisar dados experimentais utilizando ferramentas estatísticas e transformar resultados em insights técnicos. Elaborar relatórios técnicos para suporte à tomada de decisão e atividades regulatórias. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares em um ambiente de inovação aplicada. Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos Experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos biológicos, vacinas ou bioprocessos. Conhecimento prático em cultivo celular e/ou replicação viral. Experiência com técnicas analíticas, como PCR, titulação viral ou ensaios biológicos. Vivência em planejamento experimental e análise de dados científicos. Capacidade de comunicação técnica e elaboração de relatórios consistentes. Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais Liofilização aplicada a produtos biológicos. Formulação e estudos de estabilidade de vacinas ou biofármacos. Escalonamento de processos (scale-up) e transferência de tecnologia para ambiente industrial. Técnicas de purificação, como ultrafiltração e diafiltração tangencial (UF/DF). Aplicação de Quality by Design (Qb D) no desenvolvimento de processos. Definição e controle de parâmetros críticos (CPPs) e atributos de qualidade (CQAs). Validação analítica e estudos de biocomparabilidade. Uso de ferramentas estatísticas avançadas (ex.: Design of Experiments – Do E). Experiência com requisitos regulatórios e geração de documentação técnica Perfil colaborativo, com capacidade de atuação em times multidisciplinares e projetos complexos. Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial Formato de trabalho : Presencial / Campo Largo/PR Soft Skills : Ética e responsabilidade, Autonomia, Pensamento crítico, Organização, Trabalho em equipe e Criatividade.

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Promo writer (brasil) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations. Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices (Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e) where applicable. Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership. Required Qualifications & Skills: Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory):3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. Language Fluency:Flawless written and spokenEnglish(for US vendors/clients) andPortuguese(for local operations, banks, and agencies). title: Brazil sourcing & procurement manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Brazil sourcing & procurement manager em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Responsibilities 1. Procurement Execution & Channel Management Source, inquire, compare and negotiate prices for corn, wheat, sorghum, soybeans, soybean meal and other products originating from Brazil and surrounding regions, and complete the full procurement process. Develop and maintain partnerships with local suppliers including farms, traders and ABCD companies, build stable supply channels, and conduct supplier access, evaluation and hierarchical management. 2. Market Analysis & Cost Control Monitor weather conditions, crop planting, local policies, exchange rates, logistics as well as spot and futures prices in Brazilian producing areas, and deliver weekly and monthly market analysis reports plus procurement strategy proposals. Optimize procurement costs under the premise of guaranteed quality and delivery schedule, and manage price fixing, basis and logistics expenses. 3. End-to-End Contract & Order Management Lead business negotiations, draft and review contracts, clarifying terms regarding quality, quantity, pricing, delivery, payment, inspection and claims. Track the whole process including order preparation, loading, customs declaration, document delivery and cargo arrival to ensure smooth performance, and handle abnormalities such as cargo damage, weight shortage and quality disputes. 4. Quality & Origin Control Cooperate with internal and third-party inspection institutions to conduct on-site sampling, testing and loading supervision, ensuring all products comply with China's import standards and internal company regulations. Keep track of quality differences across major Brazilian producing areas, and rationally arrange procurement regions and schedules. 5. Logistics & Warehousing Coordination Liaise with inland transporters, port warehouses, shipping agents and freight forwarders in Brazil to optimize cargo consolidation and sea transportation plans for better efficiency and lower costs. Collaborate with domestic teams of supply chain, finance, risk control and business departments for information synchronization, account reconciliation, settlement and document filing. 6. Compliance & Risk Management Abide by local labor, tax and trade laws and regulations in Brazil, as well as China's import quarantine and customs rules. Identify and prevent risks related to trade, exchange rate, compliance and contract performance. Keep complete business files to ensure full traceability and auditability. 7. Cross-regional Collaboration & Reporting Submit procurement ledgers, cost analysis, supplier reports, weekly and monthly market reports as required. Support domestic business planning and sales demands to maintain stable and sustainable supply.Job Requirements 1. Education & Major Bachelor’s degree or above. Majors in International Trade, Logistics & Supply Chain, Agricultural Economics, Economics or related fields are preferred. 2. Work Experience At least 7 years of working experience in agricultural product procurement. Prior working experience in Brazil or practical experience with grain and oilseed businesses in South America is required. Candidates familiar with the industrial chains of corn, wheat, sorghum, soybeans and soybean meal are preferred. 3. Language Proficiency Fluent in Portuguese and English, capable of conducting business negotiations and reading & drafting contracts proficiently. Proficiency in Chinese is a plus. 4. Professional Competencies Well-versed in the full procurement workflow of bulk agricultural commodities, with solid knowledge of trade terms, contract clauses, quality inspection standards, port logistics and import compliance. Possess strong capabilities in market trend analysis, cost accounting, risk management and business negotiation. Proficient in Excel, ERP and procurement systems, and able to independently complete data analysis and report preparation. 5. Qualifications & Resources Hold valid legal working documents for Brazil. Existing supplier resources and connections with local farms and traders in Brazil are preferred. Relevant certificates for bulk commodity business or rich cross-border trade experience are an advantage. 6. Personal Qualities Willing to reside in Brazil on a long-term basis and accept frequent business trips and field work in producing areas. Able to work under pressure, with a rigorous, meticulous and principled work attitude. Possess excellent cross-cultural communication skills, team spirit and problem-solving abilities. Familiarity with Chinese culture is preferred.Descrição das Responsabilidades do Cargo 1. Execução de compras e gestão de canais de abastecimento: Responsável pela prospecção de fontes, consulta de preços, comparação de cotações, negociação de valores e efetivação das compras de milho, trigo, sorgo, soja, farelo de soja e outras commodities produzidas no Brasil e regiões adjacentes. Desenvolver e manter parcerias com fornecedores locais, como fazendas, comerciantes de grãos e empresas multinacionais do ramo ABCD; estabelecer canais de suprimento estáveis e executar os processos de admissão, avaliação e classificação hierárquica dos fornecedores. 2. Análise de mercado e controle de custos: Acompanhar as condições climáticas, plantio, políticas governamentais, taxa de câmbio, logística e preços de contratos futuros e físicos nas regiões produtoras brasileiras, elaborar relatórios semanais e mensais de análise de mercado e propor estratégias de compras. Otimizar continuamente os custos de aquisição dentro dos padrões de qualidade e prazos de entrega, controlando os preços fixados, os spreads de base e os custos logísticos. 3. Gestão completa de contratos e pedidos: Conduzir negociações comerciais, elaborar e revisar contratos, definindo claramente cláusulas de qualidade, quantidade, preço, entrega, pagamento, inspeção de qualidade e indenizações por perdas. Acompanhar todo o fluxo dos pedidos, incluindo preparo de estoque, carregamento de navios, desembaraço aduaneiro, emissão de documentos e chegada da mercadoria ao porto de destino, garantindo o cumprimento contratual. Tratar incidentes como danificação da carga, falta de peso e contestações de qualidade. 4. Controle de qualidade e origem dos produtos: Colaborar com instituições de inspeção ou terceiros independentes para realizar amostragens, análises laboratoriais e supervisão do carregamento na origem, assegurando que os produtos atendam às normas de importação chinesas e aos controles internos da empresa. Conhecer as diferenças de qualidade entre as principais regiões produtoras do Brasil e planejar racionalmente as áreas de origem dos suprimentos e o ritmo das compras. 5. Coordenação de logística e armazenagem: Interagir com empresas de transporte terrestre interno do Brasil, depósitos portuários, agentes marítimos e despachantes aduaneiros, otimizar os planos de transporte até o porto e transporte marítimo, garantindo o melhor equilíbrio entre prazo logístico e custo. Colaborar com os departamentos nacionais de cadeia de suprimentos, finanças, gestão de riscos e operações comerciais para compartilhar informações, realizar conciliações de contas, efetuar pagamentos e arquivar documentos. 6. Gestão de conformidade e prevenção de riscos: Cumprir as leis trabalhistas, tributárias e comerciais brasileiras, além das normas de quarentena aduaneira e alfândega da China. Identificar e mitigar riscos comerciais, cambiais, de conformidade e de descumprimento contratual. Arquivar todo o conjunto de documentos operacionais para garantir rastreabilidade e auditoria completa. 7. Coordenação inter-regional e elaboração de relatórios: Apresentar regularmente planilhas de controle de compras, análises de custos, relatórios de fornecedores e relatórios semanais/mensais de mercado conforme exigido. Apoiar o planejamento comercial nacional e as demandas da equipe de vendas, garantindo suprimento contínuo e continuidade das operações.

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em porto alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

About UsPocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.Role OverviewAs a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.Key Responsibilities1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in EnglishThis role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Globalmente, a Green Yellow possui um portfólio de mais de 3.500 projetos de eficiência energética, sendo mais de 1.400 no Brasil, atendendo empresas dos segmentos de varejo, indústria, telecomunicações, logística, mineração, serviços e infraestrutura. Em energia solar fotovoltaica, ultrapassa 930 MWp globalmente. No Brasil, e empresa já construiu mais de 250 MWp em usinas fotovoltaicas, além de um pipeline crescente de projetos instalados junto à carga (behind-the-meter), que integram geração solar, armazenamento em baterias (BESS), eficiência energética e gestão de energia, sobretudo para clientes comerciais e industriais (C&I). A Green Yellow posiciona-se como um player integrado de infraestrutura energética, combinando solução técnica, engenharia financeira, inteligência de dados e gestão contínua de ativos, com investimentos de longo prazo e foco na criação de valor sustentável para seus clientes. O que buscamos Graduação completa em Direito com OAB ativa; Experiência consolidada em contratos, preferencialmente em energia ou infraestrutura; Vivência em negociação de contratos complexos (contratos diversos de Energia, EPC e Seguros); Pessoa proativa, com mentalidade de dono do negócio, pensamento crítico e forte orientação para soluções; Habilidade parase comunicar com clareza, engajar diferentes públicos e influenciar decisões de forma colaborativa. Protagonismo em um setor essencial e em plena expansão; Ambiente internacional, colaborativo e com cultura de dono; Autonomia para propor, decidir e desafiar o status quo; Oportunidade decrescer junto com um negócio em transformação.

You will have significant ownership over the market, work directly with global teams, and have the opportunity to grow with the business as we invest further in Brazil and Latin America. The electricity bill stops being a burden and becomes a channel for economic opportunity, especially for the small businesses that traditional finance has always underserved. We're building an AI-first operation where agents score credit & risk, approve or decline applications, and run ownership transfers across dozens of energy distributors. This is not an automation project. It is a real business operation with real clients, real volume and real consequences, designed from day one to be run by AI agents. We are looking for the person who will make it work. What you'll operate Credit & Risk Deciding who is a good payer, who is too risky, and under what terms we should accept each client. Define and apply credit & risk criteria: evaluate payment behavior, energy consumption and other signals to determine approval, limits and risk. Run and improve the operation:m onitor decisions, portfolio health, default rates and edge cases, turning learnings into better rules and processes. Own the AI agents: define how they analyze applications, what they handle autonomously and where they escalate to you. Ownership Transfer Getting every new consumer unit (UC) fully switched over to Liora across dozens of distributors with different rules and systems. Own the process: map distributor requirements and ensure contracts and documentation are correct. Run and unblock the operation: track transfers, resolve rejections and exceptions, and keep applications moving. Own the AI agents: automate execution, define escalation points and continuously expand what agents can handle. These are complex, high-volume operations that, in the traditional model, would require large teams. At Liora, we want them run by agents, with you in command. Who you are We care less about titles and years of experience than about how you think, learn and solve problems. You don't need to have done this before. Very few people have. We're looking for someone early enough in their career to be excited by building something from scratch, but ambitious enough to take real ownership from day one. Degree and industry background don't matter. What matters is that you can move between business judgment and technical execution: understand the problem, build the solution, measure the result and improve it. You're not waiting for a defined process or formal training to get started. You enjoy figuring things out when there is no obvious answer. You spend time experimenting with AI agents because you're genuinely curious. You've tested tools, broken things, understood why they broke and tried again. Why now, why Liora The energy sector is full of opaque tariffs, fragmented processes and decades of accumulated complexity. Liora is turning that complexity into financial infrastructure for SMBs and high-consumption consumers. We're backed by Canary, 17 Sigma and 468 Capital. We doubled in size in the first two months of 2026 and project 15x growth by year end. You'll join while the category is being created, with the autonomy to build the playbook as you go. The window is open. It won't stay that way forever.

title: Senior fpga developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior fpga developer em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.Responsibilities :The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.Qualifications :BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.Required Skills :Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em porto alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About UsPocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.Role OverviewAs a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.Key Responsibilities1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in EnglishThis role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em curitiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.Qualifications :BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.Required Skills :Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Procuramos um profissional com olhar atento aos detalhes, senso estético apurado e capacidade de transformar briefings em peças impactantes para diferentes canais e plataformas. Buscamos alguém que goste de trabalhar de forma colaborativa, tenha agilidade para atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e esteja sempre em busca de inovação, contribuindo para a construção de experiências visuais relevantes que gerem valor para marcas, parceiros e consumidores. Missão da Impulso Facilitar a conexão dos anunciantes com seu público-alvo através de um planejamento estratégico analítico e mensuração rigorosa de resultados, utilizando KPIs relevantes para avaliação de performance. Prover um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível, com uma gama de benefícios voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos colaboradores, sustentado por um compromisso robusto com a diversidade e inclusão. Responsabilidades Criar peças gráficas para os canais de Mídia Programática, CRM, E-commerce e Telas Digitais, garantindo alinhamento ao briefing, à identidade visual de cada bandeira e ao conceito da campanha. Criar vídeos curtos e animações simples (motion graphics básico) para campanhas de Telas Digitais e Mídia Programática. Trabalhar em parceria com os times da agência, Canais e Account Managers, garantindo consistência visual, qualidade das entregas e cumprimento dos prazos. Adaptar peças de campanhas dos clientes para diferentes formatos, canais e plataformas, como Meta, Tik Tok, DV360, Google Ads, E-mail Marketing, SMS, Push, Banners, Telas Digitais, entre outros. Organizar e manter os arquivos dos projetos, seguindo boas práticas de nomenclatura, organização e versionamento. Participar de reuniões de briefing e alinhamento criativo, contribuindo com ideias, referências e soluções visuais. Gerenciar o desdobramento de peças por meio da plataforma Gen AI, garantindo que os materiais sejam produzidos de acordo com os formatos e especificações de cada canal. Gerenciar o fluxo de criação e desdobramento do KV dos anunciantes junto à RD, via Gen AI, garantindo a priorização das demandas e o cumprimento dos prazos. Criar e estruturar módulos de E-mail Marketing na plataforma Gen AI junto ao programador, garantindo adequação aos formatos, identidade visual e necessidades de cada campanha. Criar os elementos gráficos necessários para as ações de Live Commerce (fundo de estúdio, fichas de apresentação e afins). Qualificações: Formação em Design Gráfico, Publicidade, Comunicação Visual ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia com peças para canais de mídias online e offline. Conhecimento e vivência na área de Designer. Plataformas e Ferramentas (Conhecimento desejável): Domínio de ferramentas de design como Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator e/ou Figma. Conhecimento básico de Adobe Premiere ou After Effects para edições simples de vídeo/motion. Boa noção de composição, tipografia, cores e hierarquia visual. Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban); Domínio em MS Office. O que oferecemos?Horário flexível, modelo de trabalho híbrido, Assistência Médica, Assistência Odontológica, Vale Transporte, Fretado, Seguro de Vida, Cartão IFOOD, Convênio com o Sesc, Udemy, Welhub, Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, Auxílio creche, Kit Bebê, Day-Off de Aniversário e Descontos em Farmácia. Diversidade & Inclusão A Impulso é comprometida com a promoção da diversidade e inclusão, buscando criar um ambiente que respeite e valorize a individualidade de cada colaborador.

title: Senior ai agent engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior ai agent engineer em curitiba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About First IgniteFirst Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.The role We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse. The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a person reviews before anything happens with it. Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision, traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.What you'll do • Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling, included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK, Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud. • Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation. • Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch. • Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses. Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task. • Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate. • Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable. Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both. • Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as regression tests. • Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality. • Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy. • Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to you.Required Qualifications: • 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real users touched. • You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about a multi-step run. • You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and turned them into something an agent can call reliably. • You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against a structured source of truth. • You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included. • You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and what to do about it. • You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question being asked instead of a nearby one. • You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval for them. • You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust. • You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the furthest east we can go. You might currently be titled AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll go on what you've shipped.Preferred Qualifications: • You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking. • You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AI Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong. • You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance. • You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences. • You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável. Em um cenário de evolução tecnológica e busca por maior produtividade, a empresa fortalece sua jornada de transformação digital com foco em processos mais inteligentes, confiáveis e orientados por dados.    O projeto tem como foco o desenvolvimento e a implementação de uma metodologia integrada para mapeamento, reestruturação e automação de processos operacionais, utilizando Inteligência Artificial, análise de dados, modelagem de processos e machine learning. Se você tem doutorado em Engenharia de Produção, Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas, e interesse em atuar com transformação digital, BPM, análise estatística e automação de processos organizacionais, essa oportunidade é para você. O que buscamos Experiência anterior com gestão de projetos, atendimento, Customer Success ou operações, preferencialmente em agência ou assessoria de marketing; Experiência com gestão simultânea de múltiplos clientes e projetos; Excelente capacidade de organização e gestão de prioridades; Facilidade para acompanhar prazos, processos e responsáveis; Comunicação clara, assertiva e profissional; Capacidade de conduzir conversas e alinhamentos com clientes; Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas; Capacidade de identificar riscos e agir de forma preventiva; Proatividade e autonomia; Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes áreas e perfis profissionais; Senso de responsabilidade sobre os projetos que acompanha; Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos e organização. Experiência anterior em agência ou assessoria de marketing será considerada um grande diferencial. Diferenciais Conhecimento de ou ferramentas similares de gestão de projetos; Experiência com carteira de clientes recorrentes; Conhecimento sobre marketing digital, tráfego pago e redes sociais; Experiência com indicadores de satisfação, retenção e churn; Experiência com processos de onboarding de clientes; Vivência com metodologias de gestão de projetos e processos. O perfil que buscamos Não buscamos alguém para simplesmente perguntar: “A tarefa foi feita?” Buscamos alguém que consiga entender: “O que precisa acontecer para esse projeto avançar e quem precisa ser acionado para isso?” Para nós, um(a) Supervisor(a) de Projetos Pleno precisa ter visão do todo, organização, capacidade de cobrança, boa comunicação e senso de urgência. É alguém que percebe um possível atraso antes do prazo vencer. Que identifica um cliente insatisfeito antes do pedido de cancelamento. Que não apenas leva problemas para a liderança, mas chega com contexto, análise e possíveis soluções. E que entende que uma excelente experiência do cliente começa com uma operação organizada nos bastidores. Modelo de trabalho Contratação PJ; Jornada de 8 horas por dia; Modelo híbrido; Presencial às terças, quintas e sextas-feiras; Home office às segundas e quartas-feiras; Escritório em Santo André/SP, ao lado da Estação Prefeito Saladino; Necessário possuir CNPJ ou disponibilidade para abertura; Preferencialmente residir no ABC Paulista ou regiões de São Paulo com fácil acesso a Santo André. Remuneração Remuneração: fixo + variável por performance, com potencial de ganhos de até R$ 5.000/mês (PJ). A remuneração variável estará vinculada ao atingimento de indicadores relacionados à performance da operação, saúde da carteira e qualidade da gestão dos projetos. Os critérios e indicadores serão apresentados com transparência durante o processo seletivo. O que você encontra por aqui Ambiente de empresa em crescimento e transformação; Possibilidade real de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional; Ciclos estruturados de avaliação e acompanhamento de performance; Cultura de feedbacks recorrentes e comunicação assertiva; Contato direto com diferentes áreas da operação; Autonomia para propor melhorias, estruturar processos e contribuir para a evolução da empresa. Sobre o Grupo XNOW Nossa missão é ajudar empresas a construírem visibilidade digital que vende. Para isso acontecer, não basta ter boas estratégias. Precisamos de uma operação organizada, clientes bem acompanhados e pessoas capazes de transformar planejamento em execução. Se você gosta de organizar, liderar projetos, resolver problemas e fazer as coisas acontecerem, queremos conhecer você. Venha ser um #Laranjinha.
