title: Finance manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Finance manager em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story. Since 1997, we’ve put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future. We’re a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut. Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people. Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to comeWe are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join our team in São Paulo, Brazil. In this role, you will oversee all aspects of finance, accounting, tax, legal, IT, and treasury, including financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, cash management, and statutory compliance. You will be responsible for maintaining the full set of ledgers and accounts, managing monthly closing activities, preparing financial and statutory reports, ensuring compliance with applicable local, international, and internal accounting and tax standards, and supporting the timely and accurate consolidation of financial information for Head Office. As a business partner, you will provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and play a key role in building systems, processes, and frameworks from scratch, particularly across finance, tax, legal, and treasury. This is a highly hands-on role, especially during the initial phase, requiring you to personally execute and/or review key finance processes such as payments, bank reconciliations, tax calculations, invoicing, accounting entries, and month-end closing. We are looking for someone who is proactive, improvement-oriented, and solution-driven, with strong analytical and organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset. The ideal candidate will also have the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams while working effectively in a dynamic and growing environment.Key Responsibilities Maintain all accounting records in the ERP system to ensure accuracy of the general ledger and financial accounts. Lead the monthly and annual financial closing processes through the preparation of standard reports as well as other custom reports as requested. Review and analyse financial statements/records and provide reports and data analysis to various internal stakeholders. Manage day-to-day risk exposures, -reports and -mitigation measures such as insurances, hedges etc. Work with credit team to manage counterpart exposures and follow up on overdue receivables. Ensure adequate liquidity to support the business, support/investigate/expand local or central funding opportunities. Lead the transition of the bookkeeping from external service providers to "in-house". Ensure desired IT platform and relevant key procedures will be implemented. Coordinate and assist finance department in Brazil with the financial record keeping of the activities undertaken in Brazil. Oversee local administrative matters and purchase office supplies and equipment while maintaining appropriate stock levels in a cost-efficient manner. Manage and execute all payments and customer invoicing, including entering payment instructions into the online banking system and coordinating the required approvals to ensure payments are released accurately and within the established deadlines. Prepare and process cash claims and expense reimbursements for the Brazilian team. Advise and assist various departments on accounting, tax and legal compliance by researching and ensuring compliance to applicable internal, national and international rules and regulations. Coordinate external / internal audits and prepare audit requirements. Liaise with central teams in Singapore / Jakarta for ad-hoc queries and analysis requests. Act as the primary point of contact for office managers, IT teams, auditors, accountants, finance managers, and HR teams across other locations in the EU and Americas regions. Act as the first point of contact for external stakeholders such as banks, legal, tax authorities and other regulatory bodies, service providers.Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field 8+ years’ relevant experience in accounting, finance and trade control Strong knowledge of Brazilian and international accounting, tax and regulatory requirements. Working experience in the Commodity industry Experience with tax, legal, banking Experience with implementing IT systems and consolidation work Proficient with MS Office Experience with ERP software (SAP is an advantage) Experience working in an international environment Experience building & leading a high performing team Fluent in English, both written and spoken Fluent in Spanish, both written and spoken is preferred We Offer An entrepreneurial and international environment where developing opportunities for growth is valued Training opportunities, locally and globally Health insurance Meal support (vale refeição) Transport support/Parking lot (Vale transporte ou vaga de estacionamento)

description:

3 D Character Animator - Indie Platform Fighter I'm looking to hire an experienced3 D Character Animatorto help bring the fighters in an upcoming indie platform fighter to life. The game is a fast-paced, combat-focused platform fighter featuring gods, deities, and religious figures from different traditions battling one another. I'm looking for someone who can createdynamic, highly readable, hard-hitting combat animation , with attacks that feel powerful, responsive, expressive, and satisfying in gameplay. What I'm Looking ForRequired Strong professional portfolio demonstrating3 D character animation Ideally5–10+ years of 3 D animation experience Experience working onindie games or other real-time game projects Excellent understanding of: Combat animation Body mechanics Weight and momentum Timing, anticipation, follow-through, and impact Exaggerated poses and readable silhouettes Ability to create everything from quick jabs and movement animations tolarge, epic special attacks and finishing moves Understanding of the technical constraints of animation for real-time gameplay Comfortable iterating based on how animations actually feel in-game Strongly Preferred Cascadeur Blender Unity Experience exporting animation assets and implementing/testing them inside Unity Bonus Skills I'd especially love to find someone capable of handling more of thefull 3 D character pipeline , including: Retopology (for minor clean-up work) UV unwrapping Texturing Rigging (especially for animals, or characters with multiple arms or wings) Weight painting Character and animal animation Preparing/exporting characters and animations for Unity Troubleshooting rigs, meshes, animation clips, and import settings These additional skills are a major plus, butanimation is the priority. If you're an exceptional combat animator who specializes specifically in animation, I still want to hear from you. The Project This is an indieplatform fighterbuilt around a roster of mythological and religious characters, with an intentionally comedic, irreverent, and satirical tone. Important:The game contains deliberatelyblasphemous and sacrilegious humorand jokes about gods, religions, religious beliefs, and religious figures. Applicants need to be genuinely comfortable working on that kind of material. Who Would Be a Great Fit I'm looking for someone who: Loves making combat animation feel ridiculously satisfying Understands that gameplay readability matters as much as beautiful animation Can exaggerate movement without making it feel weightless Is comfortable working collaboratively and iterating quickly Has experience with small or independent game-development teams Can take a relatively simple stylized character and give them a huge amount of personality through movement If you've worked on a fighting game, platform fighter, action game, or anything involving exaggerated character combat, I'd especially like to see it.

title: Analista de pessoas e administraÇÃo
description:

Com sede administrativa em Curitiba/PR e operação logística em Joinville/SC, trabalhamos com processos enxutos e uma estrutura organizacional compacta, composta por equipes de 5 a 10 pessoas. Mantemos o foco na qualidade, na eficiência operacional e na excelência no atendimento ao cliente. Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem da autorresponsabilidade e da dedicação ao essencial. Nossa cultura, pautada na autonomia, colaboração, organização e praticidade, está refletida nos seguintes princípios: ● Essencialismo: Priorizamos o que gera valor. Evitamos excesso de processos e mantemos ambientes físicos e digitais organizados e funcionais. ● Responsabilidade individual: Esperamos que cada colaborador assuma o protagonismo da própria evolução, com consciência e compromisso. ● Capricho e qualidade: A atenção aos detalhes é fundamental para nosso padrão de excelência. Prezamos entregas bem executadas, com precisão e zelo. ● Melhoria contínua: Incentivamos a busca ativa por conhecimento. Entendemos que aprender e aprimorar são necessidades constantes. ● Mentalidade orientada à solução: Além de identificar problemas e desafios, nossos profissionais buscam soluções viáveis, traduzindo ideias em planos de ação.2. SOBRE A VAGA Cargo: Analista de Pessoas e Administração Local: Sede administrativa – Rebouças, Curitiba/PR Tipo de contratação: PJ (híbrido) Remuneração: R$ 4.200,00 Benefícios: - PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) - Bonificação trimestral por desempenho: +50% - Bonificação anual por meta da empresa batida: 14o Salário3. ATRIBUIÇÕES O Analista de Pessoas e Administração é responsável pela execução, controle e melhoria contínua dos processos relacionados à gestão de pessoas, rotinas administrativas e suporte organizacional. Atua de forma operacional, analítica e estratégica, garantindo a eficiência dos processos de recrutamento e seleção, administração de pessoal, desenvolvimento de pessoas, comunicação interna e apoio às lideranças. A função está fundamentado em três pilares principais: Pessoas:encontrar, contratar e desenvolver profissionais alinhados à cultura da empresa, garantindo que todas as rotinas de liderança, acompanhamento, feedback e desenvolvimento sejam executadas de forma consistente, registradas e mantidas ativas; Ambiente:criar e preservar um ambiente organizado, saudável e produtivo, focando no bem-estar das pessoas para que tenham condições de entregar seu melhor desempenho; Suporte Administrativo:assumir demandas administrativas que ainda não possuam responsável definido, garantindo sua correta execução, direcionamento ou incorporação à rotina da área quando necessário.Suas responsabilidades incluem: ● Conduzir processos de recrutamento e seleção de ponta a ponta; ● Divulgar vagas, realizar triagem de currículos, entrevistas e acompanhamento de candidatos; ● Organizar admissões, desligamentos, folha de pagamento, benefícios, controle de ponto, férias e demais rotinas de RH e Departamento Pessoal; ● Garantir a organização, atualização e controle de documentos, registros e acessos internos; ● Acompanhar avaliações de desempenho, PDIs, one-on-ones, feedbacks, engajamento e demais ciclos de liderança; ● Garantir que as rotinas de gestão de pessoas sejam executadas dentro dos prazos e padrões definidos pela empresa; ● Manter atualizados RCFs, registros, históricos e controles relacionados aos colaboradores; ● Apoiar ações de comunicação interna, fortalecimento da cultura e integração entre equipes; ● Criar materiais internos, apresentações, comunicados e demais conteúdos institucionais; ● Organizar treinamentos, eventos corporativos e ações de engajamento; ● Resolver e organizar demandas administrativas do dia a dia, garantindo continuidade operacional; ● Garantir a organização e o bom funcionamento dos ambientes corporativos; ● Estruturar, documentar e aprimorar processos internos sempre que necessário; ● Atuar como ponto de apoio para lideranças e colaboradores em assuntos relacionados à gestão de pessoas e rotinas administrativas; ● Monitorar indicadores da área e propor melhorias que contribuam para o desenvolvimento das equipes e da organização.4. REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÃO Competências obrigatórias: - Ensino superior cursando ou concluído em Recursos Humanos, Administração, Psicologia, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas; - Experiência com recrutamento e seleção de ponta a ponta; - Experiência com rotinas completas de Departamento Pessoal; - Conhecimento intermediário de Excel e ferramentas digitais de gestão; - Boa noção de design, layout e comunicação visual: capacidade de organizar informações visualmente de forma clara, agradável e profissional, tendo facilidade com ferramentas como Canva, Power Point ou similares para produção de materiais internos; - Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.Competências desejadas: - Experiência com cultura organizacional, comunicação interna e ações de engajamento; - Experiência na organização de treinamentos e eventos corporativos.5. EXPECTATIVAS O que buscamos: ● Organização e proatividade: senso de prioridade, autonomia para conduzir múltiplas atividades; ● Bom relacionamento interpessoal: interesse genuíno por pessoas, comunicação clara e acolhedora, capacidade de construir ambientes saudáveis e produtivos; ● Pensamento analítico e estruturado: atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de análise e julgamento, habilidade para compreender perfis e identificar talentos; ● Foco em melhoria contínua; ● Perfil organizado, com zelo por documentos, prazos, eventos, agendas e rotinas administrativas; ● Capacidade de transformar processos e comunicações em experiências claras e organizadas;O que oferecemos: ● Treinamento técnico e desenvolvimento pessoal; ● Direcionamento estratégico; ● Cobrança objetiva; ● Liberdade com responsabilidade; ● Sinceridade e transparência.6. ETAPAS DO PROCESSO SELETIVO ● Triagem de currículos – Análise de perfil profissional. ● Pré-entrevista com responsável RH – Contato inicial para esclarecimento de informações e alinhamento de expectativas. ● Teste avaliativo – Enviado por e-mail aos candidatos selecionados. ● Entrevista CEO – Avaliação final. ● Feedback e contratação – Formalização da contratação.

Ambiente criativo, colaborativo e com energia real (confira nosso Linked In!). Liberdade para criar, testar, errar e refazer - aqui a criatividade é viva, ouvida e praticada. Suas ideias vão ganhar forma e impacto todos os dias.    Local Presencial - Barueri/SP | Segunda a sexta, horário comercial.      Envie seu portfólio (artes e vídeos) e mostre o que você já criou. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.The Role- Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M&A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration. - Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. - Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses. - Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so. - If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.What You'll Bring- 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house. - Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief. - Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions). - Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up. - Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client. - Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.Why Moritz- Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn. - Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. - Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. - Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.Frequently Asked QuestionsHow many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

title: Arquiteto de soluções
description:
Empresa está contratando Arquiteto de soluções em barueri. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Estamos buscando um Arquiteto de Soluções / Desenvolvedor AWS para fazer parte do time!      Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor / Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software e atuação comprovada no desenho de arquiteturas de soluções AWS. O foco principal é construir, evoluir e sustentar aplicações em produção, combinando qualidade de código, visão arquitetural e domínio prático de cloud.    Este profissional atuará de forma hands-on em decisões de arquitetura, implementação de componentes críticos, integração de serviços AWS, automação de infraestrutura, observabilidade, segurança, confiabilidade e otimização de custos.    A função é de contribuição individual e não inclui responsabilidade formal de Tech Lead ou gestão de pessoas. Experiência em discovery, pré-vendas e comunicação técnica com clientes será valorizada como diferencial e utilizada pontualmente.      Desenvolvimento de software   • Projetar, desenvolver, testar, revisar e manter aplicações, APIs, microsserviços, integrações e componentes críticos em produção.   • Aplicar clean code, SOLID, design patterns, tratamento de erros, testes automatizados, segurança e documentação.   • Atuar com Python, Node.js, Type Script, Go ou linguagem equivalente, demonstrando profundidade em pelo menos uma stack de produção.   • Realizar code reviews, troubleshooting e análise de performance, contribuindo tecnicamente com o time sem assumir liderança formal de pessoas.   • Modernizar aplicações legadas e avaliar a adoção pragmática de serverless, containers, microsserviços e eventos.      Arquitetura de soluções   • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções seguras, escaláveis, resilientes, observáveis e financeiramente sustentáveis.   • Criar diagramas de contexto, componentes, sequência, integração, dados, rede, segurança e implantação com ícones AWS, C4, UML ou notação equivalente.   • Registrar decisões com Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), incluindo contexto, alternativas, trade-offs e consequências.   • Definir disponibilidade, capacidade, latência, escalabilidade, RTO, RPO, backup, disaster recovery e prontidão para produção.   • Avaliar serviços e revisar soluções com base no AWS Well-Architected Framework, equilibrando operação, segurança, confiabilidade, performance, custo e sustentabilidade.   • Construir provas de conceito e apoiar o detalhamento técnico e o handoff das soluções.      Cloud, Dev Ops e operação   • Implementar infraestrutura com Terraform, módulos reutilizáveis, gestão de estado, pipelines e controles para Infrastructure as Code.   • Criar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD, testes automatizados, controles Dev Sec Ops e estratégias seguras de deployment e rollback.   • Implementar observabilidade com logs, métricas, traces, alarmes, dashboards e SLI/SLO.   • Investigar incidentes e falhas complexas, participar de análise de causa raiz e implementar ações preventivas.   • Aplicar segurança por design, least privilege, gestão de segredos, criptografia, proteção de perímetro e rastreabilidade.   • Otimizar continuamente custo, performance, capacidade e confiabilidade.      Apoio técnico a clientes e pré-vendas - Desejável   • Participar pontualmente de discovery técnico, workshops, estimativas, provas de conceito e apresentações para clientes.   • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em alternativas técnicas, premissas, riscos, estimativas de esforço e custos AWS.   • Explicar decisões e trade-offs com clareza para públicos técnicos, executivos e comerciais.   • Apoiar respostas a RFPs, RFIs e questionários técnicos ou de segurança quando necessário.      Serviços e Conhecimentos Relevantes    Desenvolvimento e arquitetura    APIs REST/Graph QL, sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços, serverless, eventos, cache, consistência, idempotência e resiliência.    Computação    EC2, Auto Scaling, Lambda, ECS, EKS, Fargate, ECR, containers e seleção entre compute gerenciado, serverless e Kubernetes.    Redes e entrega    VPC, subnets, Security Groups, Route 53, ELB, Cloud Front, API Gateway, Private Link, Transit Gateway, VPN e conectividade híbrida.    Dados e integração    S3, RDS/Aurora, Dynamo DB, Elasti Cache, SQS, SNS, Event Bridge, Step Functions, Kinesis ou MSK; Glue, Athena e Redshift como diferenciais.    Segurança e identidade    IAM, IAM Identity Center, KMS, Secrets Manager, ACM, WAF, Shield, Cloud Trail, AWS Config, Guard Duty, Security Hub e least privilege.    Governança    AWS Organizations, Control Tower, SCPs, landing zones, contas multi-account, tagging, políticas e segregação de ambientes.    Observabilidade e resiliência    Cloud Watch, X-Ray/Open Telemetry, logs, métricas, traces, AWS Backup, alta disponibilidade, RTO/RPO e testes de recuperação.    Automação e entrega    Terraform, módulos, state, pipelines Ia C, Git, CI/CD, testes, deployment, Systems Manager e noções de Cloud Formation ou CDK.    Fin Ops e IA    Cost Explorer, Budgets, Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans e alocação de custos; Bedrock, RAG, agentes e guardrails como diferenciais. title: Líder técnico
description:

Estamos buscando um Arquiteto de Soluções AWS / Tech Lead - Hands-on para fazer parte do time!      Descrição do cargo    Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto de Soluções AWS / Tech Lead Sênior, com atuação hands-on, responsável por transformar necessidades de negócio e requisitos de clientes em soluções seguras, escaláveis, resilientes, observáveis e financeiramente sustentáveis. Também será responsável por exercer a liderança técnica da equipe, estabelecer padrões de engenharia, facilitar decisões, apoiar a resolução de problemas complexos e desenvolver tecnicamente profissionais de diferentes níveis de senioridade. A posição exige excelente comunicação com públicos técnicos, executivos, comerciais e clientes      Arquitetura e decisões técnicas    Conduzir discovery técnico, identificando requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, restrições, riscos, integrações, requisitos regulatórios e critérios de sucesso.   • Definir arquiteturas de alto e baixo nível, incluindo diagramas de contexto, componentes, sequência, integração, rede, segurança, dados e implantação.   • Documentar decisões por meio de Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), registrando contexto, alternativas, trade-offs, impactos e consequências.   • Definir requisitos de disponibilidade, capacidade, latência, escalabilidade, observabilidade, RTO, RPO, backup e recuperação de desastres.   • Conduzir revisões com base nos seis pilares do AWS Well-Architected Framework: excelência operacional, segurança, confiabilidade, eficiência de performance, otimização de custos e sustentabilidade.   • Avaliar alternativas técnicas e selecionar serviços AWS considerando adequação ao problema, segurança, custo total, esforço operacional e riscos de dependência.   • Criar e manter padrões, arquiteturas de referência, guias e componentes reutilizáveis.      Pré-vendas e relacionamento com clientes   • Trabalhar em parceria com o time comercial durante discovery, qualificação e desenho de oportunidades.   • Participar de reuniões, workshops e apresentações técnicas com clientes, adaptando a comunicação ao público técnico ou executivo.   • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em propostas técnicas, arquiteturas, escopo, premissas e planos de implementação.   • Elaborar estimativas de esforço, capacidade, custos AWS e Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).   • Apoiar respostas a RFPs, RFIs, questionários técnicos, requisitos de segurança e processos de due diligence.   • Criar e apresentar demonstrações e provas de conceito, tratando objeções e explicando alternativas, riscos e trade-offs.   • Realizar handoff estruturado entre vendas e delivery, assegurando alinhamento entre a solução proposta e a implementação.      Liderança técnica e desenvolvimento da equipe   • Atuar como Tech Lead e principal referência técnica da equipe, sem necessariamente exercer gestão administrativa de pessoas.   • Facilitar decisões e criar alinhamento entre engenharia, projetos, produto, segurança, operações e vendas.   • Estabelecer padrões de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, testes, segurança, observabilidade, documentação e revisão de código.   • Orientar o roadmap técnico, a evolução das plataformas e a priorização de débito técnico e riscos de engenharia.   • Conduzir design reviews, code reviews e revisões de prontidão para produção com critérios objetivos de qualidade.   • Realizar mentoria, pairing e feedback técnico, apoiando planos de desenvolvimento de profissionais júnior, pleno e sênior.   • Promover treinamentos internos, comunidades de prática e compartilhamento de conhecimento, reduzindo dependências individuais.   • Apoiar recrutamento, entrevistas e avaliação técnica de candidatos.   • Influenciar decisões técnicas com clareza, respeito e dados, mesmo sem autoridade hierárquica direta.      Implementação, operação e melhoria contínua   • Liderar o desenho e a implementação de soluções utilizando Terraform e práticas avançadas de Infrastructure as Code.   • Desenvolver provas de conceito e componentes críticos utilizando Python, Node.js, Type Script, Go ou outra linguagem adotada pela equipe.   • Definir e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD, controles Dev Sec Ops, estratégias de deployment e automação de testes.   • Liderar iniciativas de modernização, integração de sistemas legados e adoção responsável de serviços gerenciados.   • Integrar soluções de Gen AI, APIs de LLMs e automação inteligente com controles de segurança, privacidade, avaliação e observabilidade.   • Realizar troubleshooting avançado e liderar tecnicamente incidentes críticos, análise de causa raiz e post-mortems sem culpabilização.   • Conduzir ações de Fin Ops, capacity planning e otimização contínua de custos, performance e confiabilidade. A posição não exige domínio prático de todos os serviços citados, mas requer visão sistêmica, entendimento de trade-offs e habilidade para aprender rapidamente novas capacidades da plataforma. Requisitos   • Experiência relevante em engenharia de software, infraestrutura ou cloud, com atuação significativa em AWS.   • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead, Arquiteto de Soluções ou principal referência técnica de uma equipe.   • Histórico de desenho, implantação e sustentação de soluções AWS em produção.   • Experiência conduzindo reuniões técnicas com clientes ou apoiando atividades de pré-venda.   • Capacidade de produzir e apresentar diagramas utilizando ícones oficiais AWS, C4, UML ou notação equivalente.   • Experiência com arquitetura de software, APIs, sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços, integração orientada a eventos e serverless.   • Experiência com Terraform, pipelines CI/CD, containers, observabilidade e práticas de Dev Sec Ops.   • Capacidade de estimar esforço, capacidade, custo e riscos técnicos de soluções.   • Conhecimento de segurança por design, governança, alta disponibilidade, disaster recovery e Fin Ops.      Diferenciais   • Certificação AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional.   • Certificação AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate.   • Certificações AWS Certified Security - Specialty ou AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer - Professional.   • Experiência com Azure, GCP, ambientes híbridos ou estratégias multi-cloud.   • Experiência com Amazon Bedrock, agentes, RAG, avaliação de modelos e soluções corporativas de IA generativa.   • Experiência em consultoria, serviços profissionais, ambientes regulados ou atendimento a clientes enterprise.   • Inglês técnico ou avançado para documentação, apresentações e interação com clientes ou parceiros internacionais. Redes e entrega  VPC, Route 53, Transit Gateway, Private Link, Elastic Load Balancing, Cloud Front, API Gateway, Direct Connect e VPN.   Segurança  KMS, Secrets Manager, ACM, WAF, Shield, Guard Duty, Security Hub, Inspector, Macie, least privilege e threat modeling.   Computação  EC2, Auto Scaling, Lambda, ECS, EKS, Fargate, ECR, containers e arquiteturas serverless.   Dados e integração  S3, RDS/Aurora, Dynamo DB, Elasti Cache, SQS, SNS, Event Bridge, Step Functions, Kinesis, MSK, Glue, Athena e Redshift.   Observabilidade e resiliência  Cloud Watch, X-Ray, Open Telemetry, AWS Backup, Resilience Hub, Fault Injection Service, Elastic Disaster Recovery, SLI/SLO e testes de recuperação.   Engenharia e automação  Terraform em ambientes complexos, módulos e pipelines Ia C; conhecimento de Cloud Formation ou CDK; CI/CD, Git, testes automatizados e Systems Manager.   Fin Ops  Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, Cost and Usage Reports/Data Exports, Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans, tagging e alocação de custos. We power Super Apps, Fin Techs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.      WHAT YOU WILL DO Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships    WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE 8+ years of B2 B enterprise partnerships experience Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, Di Di, Mercado Pago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, i Food or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred    PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia    WHAT WE OFFER Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate Remote-first with regional travel as required Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM    MARKET CONTEXT    Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Senior it project manager (sales)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior it project manager (sales) em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Description:    The IT Sales Project Manager is responsible for simultaneously directing multiple cross-functional technology projects that support sales operations, customer experience, sales enablement, pricing coordination, and commercial growth. The PM owns delivery across the triple constraints of time, budget, and scope for low- to medium-risk projects and may support more complex initiatives under a senior project or program leader. This role manages an average of 3-5 projects, assembles project teams, builds and manages project plans, coordinates internal and vendor resources, tracks milestones, manages risks and dependencies, and communicates project status to business and IT stakeholders. The PM must be comfortable bridging Sales, Marketing, Pricing, Finance, IT, vendor, and field teams while driving accountability, stakeholder alignment, and practical problem solving. This role requires a home office setup that allows stationary work on camera for most of the day, including an HD webcam, hardwired high-speed internet, and a stationary workstation. The incumbent must work Eastern Standard Time business hours regardless of location.      Major Tasks, Responsibilities, and Key Accountabilities   Manages 3-5 small- to medium-scale Sales technology projects from planning to completion by facilitating working sessions, building and maintaining project plans, managing schedules and resource forecasts, tracking deliverables, and escalating issues with clear recommendations. Partners with Sales, Marketing, Pricing, Finance, IT, vendor, and field stakeholders to clarify scope, success metrics, dependencies, adoption needs, and decision points. Translates business needs into actionable delivery plans and keeps technical and non-technical audiences aligned. Manages project financials by building forecasts, tracking actuals, validating budget assumptions, documenting cost drivers, and communicating budget impacts or tradeoffs to leadership. Coordinates the work of assigned project resources by requesting support based on project needs, clarifying roles and responsibilities, facilitating team meetings, following up on action items, and providing feedback on delivery quality and accountability. Manages risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies by identifying trigger events, documenting mitigation plans, supporting contingency planning, and influencing stakeholders to take timely action. Supports vendor oversight for Sales technology initiatives by tracking contractual deliverables, coordinating vendor timelines, supporting RFI/RFP activities as directed, and ensuring vendor work is aligned to project commitments. Adheres to enterprise project management practices by maintaining project artifacts, tracking key metrics, supporting governance routines, capturing lessons learned, and contributing continuous improvement ideas to the PMO. Provides hands-on project support when needed, which may include coordinating data validation, adoption readiness, training materials, rollout logistics, reporting, meeting notes, or other non-standard tasks required to keep delivery moving.  Preferred Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field. PMI Certified associate in project management (CAPM) or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred. 5+ years of project management experience, including IT or related business experience. 3+ years supporting projects in Sales, Marketing, Pricing, CRM, customer experience, order-to-cash, field enablement, distribution, manufacturing, or commercial technology environments preferred. Experience working with project life cycle methodologies, including waterfall, agile, hybrid, and product/wave-based delivery models. Experience influencing and managing cross-functional project teams without formal direct reporting relationships. Knowledge of PMI-based project management competency areas and experience applying these methods to deliver successful projects. Analytical skills required to manage budgeting, forecasting, risk management, process management, quality control, reporting, and executive-ready status communications. Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to interact across all levels of management and translate between business and technical audiences. Experience with Sales or commercial platforms such as Salesforce or CRM applications, pricing tools, customer analytics, marketing automation, ERP integrations, order management, reporting tools, or field technology preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Office products, particularly Excel, Power Point, Word, Visio, Share Point, Teams, and project management tools such as Smartsheet and Jira.

title: Escalation specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Escalation specialist em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About us:  Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?      About you:  This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Escalation Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.      What You’ll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.    What We’re Looking For: 5+ years in an inside sales, customer retention, client recovery, or account management role. Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet. Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts. Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure. Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies. Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality. Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value. Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player. Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday.   ✨ Bonus Points: Experience working at a CPaa S or Martech Saa S company. Experience working with real estate professionals.   ⚡️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role    Please Don’t Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You’re not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don’t meet the minimum experience

Nova oportunidade para Coordenador de vendas em barueri. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Por que trabalhar conosco?      Temos uma cultura de expansão, crescemos todos anos. Estamos no Brasil todo. Você pode crescer muito mais em uma empresa em ascensão como a nossa.      Atualmente contamos com mais de 5.000 processos ativos em 14 áreas de atuação, realizando um atendimento de cerca de mais de 7.000 pessoas todos os meses por todo o Brasil.      Nossa equipe está com quase 50 colaboradores. Estamos acelerando a empresa e buscamos uma pessoa qualificada para nos ajudar a alcançar as metas.      Temos uma equipe de alta performance, e atualmente estamos com:   +5.000 processos ativos (fora os arquivados)   +85.000 novos leads por ano   +10 anos de experiência jurídica   +40 colaboradores na equipe     ---------------    Detalhes sobre a vaga     Temos um software de CRM funil de vendas (Pipedrive) que permite registrar informações chave para facilitar criar o relacionamento O time comercial é estruturado em qualificador, fechador e pós-venda Foco da vaga é auxiliar o gestor de vendas a monitorar índices, taxas de fechamento, encontrar gargalos de vendas, análises e acompanhar desempenho dos vendedores e qualificadores O foco é especializar para ganhar eficiência No entanto, não temos cultura de braço curto. “Isso não faz parte da minha vaga” não existe aqui Meta é inegociável, tem que ser batida   ---------------    Candidato ideal      Há tipos diferentes de perfil de lead potencial, por isto é essencial que você tenha:   Capacidade analítica para entender qual lead fecha contrato e qual não fecha; Capacidade analítica para entender o motivo do lead não ter fechado e ir participando da melhoria do script. Capacidade de criar relatórios, com o objetivo de entender qual perfil fecha mais ou menos para ajudar a crescer as vendas   ---------------    Qualificações     3+ anos de experiência em vendas Excelente skill de comunicação Habilidade de se auto-organizar e de priorização de trabalho Capacidade de analisar dados, fazer relatórios e tirar conclusões de métricas de vendas

title: Gerente de e-commerce
description:
Confira a vaga para Gerente de e-commerce em barueri. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Resumo    Marca de beleza em crescimento acelerado, com operação 100% digital e Tik Tok Shop como principal canal de vendas, busca pessoa gestora de e-commerce e marketplaces para assumir a operação técnica da loja de ponta a ponta.    Hoje temos tráfego, conteúdo e afiliadas rodando em alto volume. O que falta é quem domine o setup e a operação da plataforma: configuração do Seller Center, políticas de envio e fulfillment, integração com Shopify e ERP, saúde da loja e resolução de incidentes. Você será a referência técnica dessa área e responderá diretamente à diretoria.    Trabalho 100% remoto.    Responsabilidades Configurar e manter a loja no Tik Tok Shop Seller Center: cadastro, documentação, políticas de envio, modalidades de frete, prazos de preparação e postagem Garantir a integração entre Tik Tok Shop, Shopify e ERP (emissão de nota fiscal, sincronização de estoque, preço e status de pedidos) Monitorar a saúde da loja diariamente: indicadores de fulfillment, taxa de cancelamento, advertências e violações de política Conduzir recursos e contestações junto às plataformas quando houver bloqueios, penalidades ou cancelamentos em massa Estruturar o fluxo operacional de pedidos, do recebimento à postagem, junto com a equipe de logística Cadastrar e manter o catálogo de produtos (SKUs, variações, imagens, descrições) nos canais de venda Apoiar a expansão para outros marketplaces e para o e-commerce próprio em Shopify Documentar processos e configurações para que a operação não dependa de conhecimento tácito  Qualificações Experiência comprovada operando lojas em marketplaces (Tik Tok Shop, Shopee, Mercado Livre, Amazon ou similares), incluindo configuração de políticas de envio e fulfillment Experiência com Shopify e integrações com ERP (Olist/Tiny, Bling ou similares) Vivência com recursos, contestações e recuperação de lojas penalizadas Perfil hands-on: a pessoa configura, testa e corrige, não apenas coordena Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas técnicos de integração e sincronização de estoque Diferenciais: experiência com Tik Tok Shop no Brasil, atuação em marcas de beleza/cosméticos, conhecimento de tráfego pago e afiliados no Tik Tok

title: Executivo de vendas - closer
description:
Empresa está contratando Executivo de vendas - closer em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Nós somos a Easy Jur e estamos mudando o mundo!    A Easy Jur é uma Legaltech que tem como missão revolucionar a forma de trabalho do advogado por meio da inteligência humana e artificial. Sabemos que construímos algo que é genuinamente útil para as pessoas: todo advogado ou advogada que adota o #easyjur como sua solução central tem percebido rapidamente os benefícios gerados pela transformação digital.    Acreditamos que pensar e fazer diferente é o caminho para superar as injustiças que vivemos e transformar as dificuldades em combustível para criar não somente um software jurídico e sim construir um mundo mais justo.      Seja um #Easyforce com a gente!    O que a gente espera de você?    Buscamos uma pessoa talentosa que queira fazer parte de um time de alta performance. A pessoa ideal precisa estar alinhada a nossa cultura, apresentando sede de vencer, tenha habilidade de resolver problemas, proativa, autogerenciável, analítica, focada, resiliente, que goste de pensar fora da caixa e de trabalhar em equipe.      Essa pessoa será responsável por proporcionar mudanças ao operador do Direito com o sistema Easyjur, com objetivo de mapear os desafios e necessidades para oferecer soluções criativas para nossos clientes, tornando a vida das pessoas mais simples, agradável e produtiva.      No seu dia a dia, você vai:   Conduzir reuniões de Discovery e Demonstração focadas em Impacto, utilizando o framework SPICED (Situação, Dor, Impacto, Evento Crítico e Decisão) para diagnosticar o cliente antes de prescrever a solução. Construir e documentar o objetivo de 01º impacto junto ao cliente durante o fechamento, garantindo que as metas de negócios dele estejam mapeadas. Realizar o Handoff (passagem de bastão) para o time de Customer Success (CSM), entregando o SPICED preenchido no CRM e o contexto claro para garantir o Time-to-Value rápido. Gerenciar o funil de vendas com rigor, mantendo a higiene dos dados no CRM atualizada para garantir a precisão do Forecast nas reuniões de Pipeline Review. Atuar em forte colaboração dentro do seu Sales POD, participando das Dailies de alinhamento com seu SDR e CSM para destravar negócios em conjunto. Aplicar o conceito de Trading (Troca de Valor) no lugar da negociação tradicional, defendendo o preço com base no impacto racional e/ou emocional.    Oferecemos o pacote de benefícios para PJ:   Plano de Saúde Benefício Bem estar (Investimento para atividade física) Programa Easy Family (Benefício mensal para Easyforces que tem filhos com até 10 anos de idade) Auxílio Internet (Home Office) Day off em seu aniversário; Bolsa de 50% para curso de inglês; Bolsa para especializações e estudos; Plano de desenvolvimento e crescimento; Possibilidade de contrato stock options; Bônus por indicação de novos colaboradores e/ou prestadores de serviços. Benefício Moradia/Aluguel (Para profissionais que querem mudar para Uberaba-MG)    Se você se identifica com a vaga, canditate-se e venha construir um mundo mais justo com a gente!

title: Creative strategist
description:
Empresa está contratando Creative strategist em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.      We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.      Responsibilities    Creative Strategy Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels    Performance & Media Buying Integration Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction. Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads    AI & Creative Innovation Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing. Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).    Qualifications Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing. Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred. Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads). Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.    Working hours 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday) Fully-remote    Compensation $3,500 to $5,000/month    If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

title: Closer de vendas inbound (saas por assinatura)
description:
Confira a vaga para Closer de vendas inbound (saas por assinatura) em blumenau. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Vaga remota, com preferência para quem mora em Blumenau e região. A empresa fica aqui — dá para sentar junto nas primeiras semanas, treinar pessoalmente e encurtar a curva de aprendizado. Depois disso você toca de onde quiser.      A Marca aí é um sistema de gestão para empresas que atendem em campo: climatização, dedetização, limpeza, manutenção predial, elétrica e serviços em geral. Ele resolve o dia inteiro dessas empresas em um lugar só — a vitrine onde o cliente agenda, a agenda da equipe sem conflito, as rotas do dia, a execução com foto e checklist, o relatório entregue ao cliente, a cobrança pelo Whats App e o controle do que entrou e do que falta receber. Assinatura de R$ 197 por mês.      Investimos em tráfego pago todos os dias. O lead chega até você já sabendo o que é o produto e com interesse real. Seu trabalho não é caçar cliente frio: é atender rápido, conduzir a conversa, fechar e garantir que o cliente entre no sistema e comece a usar de verdade.      QUEM VOCÊ VAI ATENDER      Dono de empresa de serviço, não startup. Gente que hoje toca a operação no caderno, na planilha e no grupo de Whats App, e que perde dinheiro com agenda bagunçada, técnico rodando à toa e cobrança esquecida. Você precisa saber conversar com esse público.      O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER     • Atender os leads que chegam do tráfego pago (Whats App, formulário e direct), com resposta em minutos: velocidade é o principal fator de conversão aqui   • Conduzir a demonstração do sistema e fechar a assinatura   • Fazer o onboarding do novo cliente: primeiro acesso, configuração e primeiro resultado   • Follow-up estruturado de quem não fechou na primeira conversa   • Registrar tudo no CRM e apresentar seus números toda semana      O QUE PRECISAMOS QUE VOCÊ JÁ TENHA     • Experiência comprovada em vendas inbound no digital: Saa S, software, serviço recorrente ou infoproduto   • Domínio de Whats App como canal de venda: ritmo, áudio, follow-up sem ser inconveniente   • Conforto em call de vídeo com câmera aberta e compartilhamento de tela   • Disciplina de CRM e de métrica: você sabe dizer sua taxa de conversão sem chutar   • Internet estável, computador próprio e disponibilidade em horário comercial      REMUNERAÇÃ O (PJ)     • Fixo mensal de R$ 1.000   • 30% da 1ª mensalidade de cada cliente fechado   • 50% da 2ª mensalidade, quando o cliente segue ativo   • 10% de cada mensalidade seguinte, todo mês, enquanto o cliente permanecer ativo   • Acelerador: acima de 20 vendas no mês, a comissão da 1ª mensalidade sobe para 50%      Na prática, no 6º mês: 8 vendas por mês chega perto de R$ 2.800; 15 vendas por mês, cerca de R$ 4.400; 25 vendas por mês, mais de R$ 7.600. E a carteira de recorrência continua pagando todo mês enquanto os clientes estiverem ativos.      MODELO      Remoto, com preferência regional para Blumenau e região (SC). title: Regional sales representative
description:
Nova oportunidade para Regional sales representative em santa catarina. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

SC — Regional Sales Representative    Quectel | LATAM | Sales & Business Development      Position Details    Job Title: SC — Regional Sales Representative    Department: Sales & Business Development — LATAM    Reports To: Regional Sales Manager / Director, LATAM    Location: Santa Catarina, Brazil    Work Arrangement: Hybrid — with regular field visits across the assigned territory    Employment Type: Full-Time    Travel Required: Frequent travel across Santa Catarina and the LATAM region (customer visits, trade shows)      Role Overview    The SC — Regional Sales Representative will be a key growth driver for Quectel LATAM, responsible for maximizing Quectel's market share in the region on Non-Cellular product lines (e.g., GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite communication, antennas) and new market segments. This will be achieved through a dedicated focus on market analysis and by winning new verticals and customers centered on these product lines.    Acting as the face of Quectel in Santa Catarina, this professional will map and develop the full commercial potential of the territory — prospecting new customers, engaging underserved segments, and ensuring that every technology company in the region knows Quectel and its affiliate solutions.      Key Responsibilities Understand the needs and expectations of customers and provide relevant, solution-oriented recommendations. Prospect every new customer who uses any technology solutions within the assigned territory. Maintain a high volume of client and partner engagement, ensuring a minimum of 10 meetings per week while sustaining consistent productivity standards. Map and develop the full commercial potential of the assigned territory — going beyond well-known business clusters to identify and engage new client prospects and underserved market segments. Follow up on account designs for the assigned product lines within the Regional Funnel. Train the Quectel Sales Force and Rep Firms/Distributors on the assigned product lines and follow up on resulting opportunities. Create a Monthly Territory Discussion Report covering leads, technical evaluations, meeting plans, roadmap calls, and related activities. Operate CRM (customer relationship management) systems and ensure authentic, up-to-date information is available within the company. Visit exhibitor booths at trade shows to identify accounts and products that use cellular modules and obtain contact information. Ensure 100% of technology customers in the region/state get to know Quectel and its affiliate solutions.    Qualifications & Requirements    Required Experience: Minimum of 3 years in sales positions within the Io T segment. Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electronics & Communication, or other IT-related fields. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English. Customer-Centric: Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals. Location: Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with availability for frequent travel across the territory.    Preferred Knowledge of non-cellular technologies such as GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, Lo Ra, satellite communication, and antennas. Existing relationships with OEMs, design houses, system integrators, or distributors in Southern Brazil. Experience selling into smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, industrial Io T, or connected mobility verticals. Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Hub Spot) and standard productivity software. Spanish language skills a plus.    About Quectel    Quectel is a global Io T solutions provider and the world's leading supplier of cellular and GNSS modules, with a mission to build a smarter world. Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5 G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and Io T connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.      With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of Io T innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (Io T platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.      Life at Quectel LATAM    At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.     Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in Io T modules. Direct access to global R& D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams. A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.    Industries & Applications    Quectel's Io T solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:     Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions. Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility. Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking. Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring. Industrial Io T & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring. Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility. Smart Home & Consumer Io T — Connected appliances, energy management, security.    Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of Io T innovation across Latin America, backed by the global market leader with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology — Work with next-generation GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite, antenna, and cellular technologies deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion — Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of Io T experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.    Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure. Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows).    Explore Quectel — Links & Resources    We encourage all candidates to learn more about Quectel before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here.    Company & Careers    Company Website: — Global Io T solutions provider    Quectel Careers: — Open roles across the Quectel ecosystem    Quectel News & Press: — Latest company announcements    Acceleronix (Ecosystem Affiliate): — Io T platform and connectivity services    Follow Us on Social Media    Linked In: Quectel Wireless Solutions — Company updates, job posts, industry news    You Tube: Quectel on You Tube — Product demos, tech talks, and event highlights    Technical & Developer Resources    Quectel Developer Zone: developer. — Docs, SDKs, tools, and developer support    Product Selector: — Browse the full portfolio of Io T modules and antennas    Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Sr. staff accountant
description:

About Fostr Talent      Fostr Talent is a boutique remote staffing company that connects exceptional professionals with high-growth North American SMBs. We specialize in placing expert contractors in operations, customer support, marketing, technical, and finance roles—enabling our clients to scale without the overhead.     ---      We're Hiring: Controller, Client Accounting Operations      About the Role      Our client is a boutique CFO Advisory firm supporting high-growth, entrepreneurial companies. They're hiring a Controller to run month-end close and manage their offshore accounting team across a portfolio of growing businesses.      This isn't a data-entry role. You'll make judgment calls on revenue recognition, accruals, and multi-entity accounting in real time. You'll own the close calendar, audit the offshore team's work, and handle the financial anomalies that pop up when clients scale fast.      Your job is to free up the Managing Director from accounting firefighting so they can focus on advisory work and growth.     ﻿ Hours: 9 AM-5 PM EST    Compensation Range: USD $19-20/hour (40 hours per week)      ---      What You'll Do      Close Ownership   • Own month-end close end-to-end across all client entities   • Review and approve journal entries, reconciliations, and coding before posting   • Make final calls on accruals, revenue recognition, and intercompany transactions   • Maintain consistent accounting standards across a multi-entity, multi-client portfolio      Team Management   • Directly manage offshore AP/AR and bookkeeping staff   • Build clear workflows that reduce ambiguity and operational friction   • Identify work beyond offshore capabilities and either reassign or execute it yourself      Client Partnership   • Partner with the Managing Director on client accounts   • Jump on client calls when needed to translate business context into accounting workflows   • Flag financial risks and process gaps before they become problems      Reporting & Systems   • Maintain weekly cash flow forecasts and reconciliation models   • Keep vendor and customer master files title: Technical sales representative
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical sales representative em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Technical Sales – Construction Products      Location: Remote – Anywhere in LATAM    Schedule: Full-time, aligned with U. S. Eastern Time    Employment Type: Employee    Compensation: Competitive, based on experience      About the Role    We are seeking a technically knowledgeable professional to support customers with construction-related products, technical quotations, specifications, and project requirements.    This position combines technical analysis, estimating, customer communication, and sales support. The successful candidate will review project information, prepare accurate quotations, answer product-related questions, and help customers identify appropriate solutions.    This is a technical sales position rather than a general customer-service role. Training will be provided on the company’s products, quoting procedures, and sales processes.      Responsibilities Review architectural drawings, measurements, specifications, and customer requirements. Prepare accurate technical quotations and pricing proposals. Identify missing, incomplete, or contradictory project information. Communicate with customers to clarify technical requirements. Explain product options, specifications, pricing, and project considerations clearly. Coordinate with suppliers, purchasing, production, logistics, and other internal teams. Maintain accurate records of quotations, customer communications, and project updates. Follow up on open quotations and support opportunities through the sales process. Develop detailed knowledge of the company’s construction products and systems. Provide professional support to customers primarily located in the United States.    Required Qualifications Completed, or nearing completion of, a degree in a relevant technical field, such as: Architecture Civil engineering Architectural engineering Construction engineering Industrial design Product design involving physical products or building systems A closely related engineering or construction discipline Advanced professional English proficiency, approximately CEFR C1 or higher. Ability to communicate naturally and confidently with customers in English. Ability to explain technical information in a clear and organized manner. Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to understand drawings, dimensions, specifications, and product information. Availability to work full-time during the established U. S. Eastern Time schedule. Reliable computer, internet connection, webcam, and workspace suitable for professional calls and confidential business conversations.    Preferred Experience    Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:   Construction or architectural-product estimating Doors, windows, glass, glazing, cabinetry, millwork, or building materials Reading construction drawings, plans, measurements, and specifications Preparing technical quotations, estimates, or pricing proposals Coordinating with customers, suppliers, purchasing, production, logistics, or installation teams Technical sales, project coordination, or customer-facing construction roles  Previous experience with doors is helpful but not required.      Virtual-Office Environment    This position operates in a live, video-enabled virtual office during scheduled working hours. Team members are expected to keep their video enabled and remain available for real-time communication and collaboration, except during approved breaks, private conversations, or when an accommodation or applicable law requires otherwise.    Applicants should carefully consider this working arrangement before applying.      Interview Process    Qualified applicants may be invited to participate in an English-language video interview covering:   Technical education and relevant experience Experience with drawings, specifications, estimating, or quotations Problem-solving and project coordination Interest in developing a technical sales career Schedule, equipment, and virtual-office availability Compensation expectations and potential start date  Applicants will be informed before any interview is recorded, and recordings will only be collected with their consent.      Equal Opportunity We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available during the recruitment process and, where applicable, in the performance of the role.

title: Senior fpga developer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior fpga developer em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.        About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.        Responsibilities :     The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.      Qualifications :     BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.      Required Skills :     Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.      Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms
